problem: The span is printed as 'ui ≤ t i+1', which is not a valid inequality — the right-hand knot and the '<' sign are missing. A student cannot tell what the degree-0 basis is nonzero on.
fix: N_i,0(t) = 1 when u_i ≤ t < u_(i+1), and 0 outside (the very last span is usually taken closed at the right end).

problem: The symbol m is reused: in Sections 1 and 2 it is the highest knot index (U has m+1 entries), but in the surface sum it is the highest control-net index in the v direction. The same letter means two different things.
fix: Use different letters for the net, e.g. Σ over i = 0…n_u and j = 0…n_v, and say n_u+1 and n_v+1 are the numbers of control points in the u and v directions.

problem: 'Knot span' is used (uniform knots, support of Ni,p) without ever being defined for the reader.
fix: Add one line where knots are introduced: a knot span is the interval between two consecutive distinct knots, [u_i, u_(i+1)).
